source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "everyday urbanism" OR ("street life" AND (urban OR city)) OR (sidewalk AND "public space")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"everyday urbanism" OR ("street life" AND (urban OR city)) OR (sidewalk AND "public space"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("everyday urbanism" OR ("public space" AND "sidewalk") OR ("street life" AND ("city" OR "urban")))
